docs.message:
docs(pdt42): transactions and generic channels (D5)

## Intent

Map the transactions of the three core relationships and the channels the platform needs. Channels already belong to the solution space, so they say what they make easier, not how they are built.

## Key changes

- A new D5 chapter holds 13 transactions from the motivations (D3), each with a unit of value and marked where it happens today, drawn as three Transactions Boards.
- Five channels say what they make easier: effortless listing, one place to find apps, visible fitness for use, passing apps on to a class, and returning use and praise to creators. The means are decided in the MVP (D8).
- Learning with an app and working with it happen inside the app, and students thank adults in class: these have no platform channel on purpose, and their hints are ignored.
- The development plan marks D5 done and adds KD-15.

moved.why: Closes D5 (reason for the transactions without a channel, ignore, draft note removed) before D6 starts.
